description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing Git repository operations, particularly read-tree and status commands, to measure algorithmic costs related to index and tree traversal without disk I/O influence.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up the default repository environment for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a success condition for a test block, executing commands inside the block.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
